memory.content: DomainSnip is connected via a custom MCP at https://www.domainsnip.com/mcp. Each owner must add that URL and authorize their own DomainSnip account; credentials are never shared in this template.
Domain Sniper alerts on valuable DomainSnip auction finds across marketplaces. It cannot buy or bid.
